nodes.label: SingleThreadedAgentRuntime
nodes.desc: Concrete in-process AgentRuntime: start() spins a host task that drains one envelope queue until stop_when_idle.

nodes.label: send_message()
nodes.desc: Direct RPC to one AgentId; returns a future resolved by the handler's response envelope.

nodes.label: publish_message()
nodes.desc: Fire-and-forget event onto a TopicId; delivers to every current subscriber concurrently.

nodes.label: _message_queue (asyncio.Queue)
nodes.desc: Single queue holding SendMessageEnvelope, PublishMessageEnvelope and ResponseMessageEnvelope items.

nodes.label: _process_next() dispatch
nodes.desc: Pattern-matches the envelope type, runs intervention handlers, then spawns a background task per envelope.

nodes.label: InterventionHandler
nodes.desc: on_send / on_publish / on_response hooks that can rewrite or DropMessage any traffic crossing the runtime.

nodes.label: _process_send()
nodes.desc: RPC path: instantiates the recipient if needed and awaits its on_message with is_rpc=True context.

nodes.label: _process_publish()
nodes.desc: Fan-out path: get_subscribed_recipients(topic_id), skips the sender, gathers on_message for each subscriber.

nodes.label: _process_response()
nodes.desc: Ack path: sets the result on the future that send_message returned to the caller.

nodes.label: register_factory()
nodes.desc: Registers a lazy factory per agent type (BaseAgent.register wraps it); instances are created on first message.

nodes.label: _invoke_agent_factory()
nodes.desc: Calls the factory, binds AgentId and runtime onto the new instance, caches it in the instance registry.

nodes.label: stop_when_idle()
nodes.desc: Waits until the queue is fully processed, then stops the host loop; used by teams to end a run.

nodes.label: TopicId
nodes.desc: Publish channel address: a topic type plus a source key that scopes conversations.

nodes.label: TypeSubscription
nodes.desc: is_match(topic_id) filters publishes; map_to_agent() derives the target AgentId from the topic source.

nodes.label: MessageContext
nodes.desc: Per-delivery metadata: sender AgentId, topic_id, is_rpc flag, cancellation token and message id.

nodes.label: BaseGroupChat
nodes.desc: Team base class: _init registers ChatAgentContainer participants and the manager with TypeSubscriptions on the runtime.

nodes.label: run_stream()
nodes.desc: Starts the embedded runtime, sends GroupChatStart, yields the output queue until GroupChatTermination, then TaskResult.

nodes.label: GroupChatStart
nodes.desc: RPC message that kicks off a round; the manager validates state and publishes the first speaker request.

nodes.label: GroupChatRequestPublish
nodes.desc: Event published to a participant topic type telling that container it is the speaker's turn.

nodes.label: ChatAgentContainer
nodes.desc: handle_request drains the buffered thread into agent.on_messages_stream and publishes GroupChatAgentResponse back.

nodes.label: GroupChatAgentResponse
nodes.desc: Response envelope carrying the agent's Response; the manager consumes it and re-evaluates termination.

nodes.label: BaseGroupChatManager
nodes.desc: Manager actor: handle_agent_response appends the message, applies the termination condition, then _transition_to_next_speakers.

nodes.label: TerminationCondition
nodes.desc: Callable stop check returning a StopMessage or None; And/Or composition operators are defined on the base class.

nodes.label: RoundRobinGroupChatManager
nodes.desc: select_speaker returns the next name by incrementing a cyclic index over participants.

nodes.label: SelectorGroupChatManager
nodes.desc: Optional selector_func override, candidate_func filter, then an LLM JSON vote with retries and mention-count fallback.

nodes.label: SwarmGroupChatManager
nodes.desc: Scans the thread backwards for the latest HandoffMessage and follows its target agent.

nodes.label: MagenticOneOrchestrator
nodes.desc: Maintains a task ledger and a JSON progress ledger; re-plans, redirects stalled agents, or triggers the final answer.

nodes.label: AssistantAgent
nodes.desc: on_messages_stream yields events; _call_llm produces the CreateResult; memory and model context are refreshed first.

nodes.label: _process_model_result()
nodes.desc: Bounded tool-call loop (max_tool_iterations): yields ToolCallRequestEvent, executes, then optionally reflects on tool use.

nodes.label: _execute_tool_call()
nodes.desc: Parses FunctionCall args and dispatches to tools or workbenches, streaming ToolCallExecutionEvent results.

nodes.label: ChatCompletionClient
nodes.desc: Abstract create/create_stream over LLMMessage lists returning CreateResult with token usage.

nodes.label: OpenAIChatCompletionClient
nodes.desc: Main concrete client; ChatCompletionCache wraps any client, and the grpc worker runtime extends runtimes beyond one process.

nodes.label: BaseTool
nodes.desc: Wraps a typed callable with ToolSchema metadata and run_json for pydantic-validated execution.

nodes.label: Workbench
nodes.desc: Stateful tool service interface (e.g. MCP); agents list its tools dynamically instead of a static tools list.
